name: hallpals
description: HallPals monorepo - Residence hall management platform

scripts.deploy:dev: cd firebase && firebase use dev && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:prod: cd firebase && firebase use prod && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:rules:dev: cd firebase && firebase use dev && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,storage:rules
scripts.deploy:rules:prod: cd firebase && firebase use prod && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,storage:rules
scripts.deploy:functions:dev: cd firebase && firebase use dev && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:functions:prod: cd firebase && firebase use prod && firebase deploy --only functions
